display_name: SPDX SBOM Validator (EU CRA Annex I)
purpose: Validates an SPDX SBOM against the EU CRA Annex I machine-readable SBOM requirement: spdxVersion matches SPDX-2.x or SPDX-3.x, SPDXID present, all packages carry name+versionInfo+downloadLocation (or purl externalRef), relationships array non-empty. Emits sbom_valid verdict and per-package gap list. Root stage of cra-product-conformance chain.
